# Jiyology Building Construction & Plumbing

> Professional construction and plumbing contractor in Soweto, Johannesburg. SABS approved, BEE Level 1 compliant. Roofing, plumbing, paving, tiling, ceiling installation, and home renovations.

## Services

- [Our Services](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services): Complete list of six core services -- roofing, plumbing, paving, tiling and painting, ceiling installation, and home renovation -- with feature details for each.
- [Roofing Services](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services): Roof tile installation, roof sheeting, roof erection, and professional installation using SABS approved materials.
- [Plumbing Services](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services): Plumbing maintenance, repairs, emergency callouts, and installation services with quality fixtures.
- [Home Renovation](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services): Interior and exterior home renovation solutions for residential and commercial clients in Soweto and Johannesburg.

## About

- [About Us](https://www.jiyology.co.za/about): Company history founded by Vusi Jiya and Lerato Jiya. SABS approved products, BEE Level 1 compliance (50% black woman owned), professional team, and client-focused values.
- [Mission, Vision & Values](https://www.jiyology.co.za/about): Mission to exceed customer expectations, vision to provide fast and reliable solutions, and values centered on treating clients with respect and providing expert advice.

## Portfolio

- [Project Gallery](https://www.jiyology.co.za/gallery): Portfolio of completed construction and plumbing projects showcasing quality workmanship across roofing, plumbing, renovations, tiling, paving, and ceiling installation.
